title.zh: 美SEC主席：金融体系正迈向加密时代，希望股票市场上链
title.en: 美SEC主席：金融体系正迈向加密时代，希望股票市场上链

current_state.zh: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said in a CNBC interview that he wants to move stock markets onto blockchain rails and that the broader financial system is shifting toward Bitcoin and crypto.
